full_prompt_en: A cinematic science-fiction illustration shows a small white-suited figure inside a vast dark cylindrical chamber, facing a brilliant circular opening. Concentric curved wall segments sweep around the centre, their charcoal and blue-grey surfaces divided by ribs, shallow channels and narrow mechanical panels. Dim red rectangular strips punctuate the walls at corresponding positions on either side. In the middle distance, a large pale opening forms a nearly complete circle above the floor, joined at its top to a narrow vertical shaft of white light that continues beyond the upper edge. The resulting keyhole-like shape leaves the surrounding ceiling almost black. Low angular ledges follow the base of the curved walls, stepping inward toward two squat box-like structures flanking the opening. Thin upright poles and small antenna-like details rise behind these structures, softened by the brightness beyond. Near the lower centre, a solitary helmeted figure stands with its back to the viewer and both arms down at its sides. The light grey-white suit has darker gloves and boots, with a dark helmet and a pale band near the neck; the face remains completely hidden. Rough, uneven flooring extends toward the foreground, its mottled surface catching faint cool reflections and a long dark trace behind the figure. Light pours inward from the circular opening and overhead slit, outlining the suit and revealing the nearest curved surfaces while leaving deep recesses in shadow. The overall composition uses a strong central axis, enclosing arcs and a tiny still figure to contrast immense mechanical scale with an austere white glow and restrained red accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅电影感科幻插画表现一个巨大的暗色圆筒空间，白色宇航服小人物面向尽头强烈发亮的圆形开口。同心弧形墙段环绕中央展开，炭灰与蓝灰表面被肋条、浅槽和窄机械面板分隔。两侧对应位置上点缀暗红色长方形条带。中景的大亮洞在地面上方形成近完整圆形，顶部接一条窄白色竖向光缝，笔直延伸出上边缘。这种钥匙孔般的形状让周围顶壁显得近乎全黑。低矮折角台沿沿弧壁基部展开，逐渐向内收拢，尽头亮洞两侧各有一座矮方箱状结构，其后伸出细竖杆和小天线状细节，被远处强光柔化。下方中央附近，一名戴头盔的人背对观者站立，双臂垂在身体两侧。浅灰白服装配较深手套和靴子，头盔深色，颈边有浅色带，面部完全不可见。粗糙不平的地面伸向前景，斑驳表面带微弱冷色反光，人物后方延伸一条深色长痕。圆洞与上方竖缝的光向内涌入，勾亮服装并显出附近弧面，深凹处仍留在阴影中。整体构图以明确中轴、围合弧线和微小静止人物，将巨型机械空间与简洁白光、克制红色点缀形成对照。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic visual language sets immense geometric forms against a very small focal mark. Deep blacks and cool greys hold most of the frame, while a concentrated pale light establishes the visual centre and sparse warm accents add precision. Strong symmetry and receding lines create depth; broad shadow areas preserve negative space around the illuminated form. Edges alternate between hard geometric definition and haze-softened transitions near the light. The restrained palette and controlled contrast make scale legible without filling the dark field with detail. The overall effect is monumental, quiet and atmospheric, with composition and value doing more work than surface ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 电影化视觉语言将庞大几何形体与极小的焦点痕迹并置。深黑和冷灰占据大部分画幅，集中的浅色光确定视觉中心，少量暖色强调则增加精确感。严格对称与向远处汇聚的线条建立纵深，宽阔暗部在发光形体周围保留负空间。边缘在坚硬清晰的界定与光线附近的雾化过渡之间变化。克制配色和受控反差让尺度关系清楚，同时避免暗部被细节填满。整体效果宏大、安静且带空气感，构图与明度承担主要表现力。
theme_en: A small white-suited figure faces a brilliant circular opening joined to a tall vertical slit inside a dark cylindrical chamber
theme_zh: 白色宇航服小人物面向暗色圆筒空间尽头的亮圆洞，圆洞上接笔直竖缝
